name: Storm-1747
description: Microsoft attributes the Tycoon2FA phishing-as-a-service platform to Storm-1747; operators use AI to refine phishing lure content at scale (tens of millions of emails/month, ~62% of the phishing Microsoft was blocking), with AI-refined messages reaching ~54% click-through vs ~12% for traditional campaigns. The platform performs adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) attacks that defeat MFA by intercepting credentials and session tokens in real time. Microsoft
